chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled concerning a woman who was subjected to ifdaʾ that the diyyah is due.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Amir al-Mu'minin, Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: blood money or prescribed financial compensation for bodily injury
key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ أُفْضِيَتْ: a woman subjected to ifdaʾ, a severe reproductive injury

ai.seo_question: What did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام rule in the case of a woman harmed by ifdaʾ?
ai.summary: This report conveys a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding a woman who suffered ifdaʾ, a grave bodily injury. It establishes that diyyah is owed in such a case, showing the serious legal consequences attached to this harm in Shia fiqh.
